subject.title: Dashboard: widget write-back — a setState bridge capability + persisted widget state

question: Should OpenClaw accept dashboard widget write-back now, and what storage/security contract should the bridge use?
rationale: The request is useful and vision-aligned, but it creates new persisted state and iframe-to-parent trust semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor With Storage And Security Design
options.body: Proceed through the linked PR or a replacement after maintainers approve the bridge contract, SQLite or approved storage owner, capability approval semantics, and adversarial tests.

options.title: Defer Under Dashboard Roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard foundation PRs settle and the added security surface can be evaluated in context.

options.title: Reject Bundled Write-Back For Now
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide stateful custom widgets should stay outside bundled OpenClaw until an external plugin or ClawHub package proves demand.

recommendation.title: Sponsor With Storage And Security Design
recommendation.body: Proceed through the linked PR or a replacement after maintainers approve the bridge contract, SQLite or approved storage owner, capability approval semantics, and adversarial tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam this capability would extend.
